title: 第13章 为女死为女亡为女去考状元郎第14章 正五宗与魔六派
lines: “老前辈，你为何肯定你是被冤枉的？”
叶风开口询问。
根据云霜儿所言，云海宗乃是人间正道首屈一指的大派，门下弟子行侠仗义，替天行道，如果是冤案，怎么可能将一个弟子关两百多年啊。
所以叶风还是比较倾向于，对方肯定是犯了极大的门规，才会受到如此严厉的惩罚。
老人传音道：“你想啊，我一不会杀人放火，二不会拦路打劫，三不会招摇撞骗，四不会采阴补阳，不是冤案是什么？”
“老前辈，您太谦虚了。”
“叶小子，你什么意思？”
“没……没什么，夸您呢！”
“哼，算了，吃了我的烧鸡，给我讲讲外面的事儿吧，你小子很久没有进来了，你知道我有多无聊吗？”
“外面的事儿……前辈，刚进来时我就和您说了，我失忆了，我什么都不记得了。”
叶风有些为难。
总不能和这个老疯子说地球上的事儿吧。
可是这个世界发生的新闻实事，他确实不知道啊。
“那你就和老夫说说，你是怎么失忆的，这一次又因为犯了什么事儿被灌进来的！”
“前辈，我这次绝对是冤案！”
老人一只烧鸡就彻底征服了叶风。
他便将自已最近几日发生的一切，全部一股脑的与这个老人说了一番。
老人听完之后，道：“你还记得你当初为什么会去药圃吗？”
“不记得了啊。”
“我记得。”
“什么？”
叶风有些疑惑的询问道：“前辈，您怎么会知道啊。”
“小子，一年多前，你曾经被关在这里半个多月，当时你是故意犯事，为的就是将自已发配到药圃。
我记得你说过，你之所以要去药圃，是为了四株千年仙芝。
好像是别人需要这四株千年仙芝，所以你才打算将其偷回来。”
老人的话，让叶风身子一抖。
他立刻询问道：“师姐？老前辈，是谁……我是为谁偷的？”
只要弄清楚，原主当初是为谁盗取的仙芝，凶手也就呼之欲出了。
肯定是此人拿了仙芝之后不讲武德，杀人灭口。
“你没说，我猜测应该是一位姑娘。”
“姑娘？您确定？”
“为女死，为女亡，为女去考状元郎。
你一个年轻有为的小伙子，难道要为一个男人去偷东西？肯定是为了女人啊！”
老头的话，让叶风陷入了沉思。
content_en:
"Old senior, why are you so sure you were wronged?"
Ye Feng asked.
According to what Yun Shuang'er said, Yunhai Sect is the leading sect of righteousness in the world, and its disciples are heroic and upright, upholding justice for heaven. If it was an unjust case, how could a disciple be imprisoned for more than two hundred years?
Therefore, Ye Feng still prefers that the other party must have violated a huge rule to be punished so severely.
The old man sent a message: "Think about it, firstly, I can't kill people and set fires, secondly, I can't block the road and rob, thirdly, I can't cheat, and fourthly, I can't use yin to replenish yang. What's this but an unjust case?"
"Old-timer, you are too humble."
"Boy Ye, what do you mean?"
"No...it's nothing. I'm complimenting you!"
"Hmph, forget it, eat my roast chicken and tell me about what's going on outside. You haven't come in for a long time. Do you know how bored I am?"
"Things outside...Senior, I told you when I first came in. I lost my memory. I don't remember anything."
Ye Feng was a little embarrassed.
You can't talk about things on earth with this old madman.
But he really doesn’t know the actual news happening in this world.
"Then tell me how you lost your memory and why you were forced in because of something you committed this time!"
"Senior, I am definitely unjust this time!"
The old man completely conquered Ye Feng with just one roast chicken.
He told the old man everything that had happened in the past few days.
After hearing this, the old man said, "Do you still remember why you went to the medicine garden in the first place?"
"I don't remember."
"I remember."
"What?"
Ye Feng asked with some confusion: "Senior, how could you know."
"Boy, more than a year ago, you were locked up here for more than half a month. At that time, you committed a crime deliberately in order to distribute yourself to the medicine garden.
I remember you said that the reason why you went to the medicine garden was for the four thousand-year-old fairy mushrooms.
It seems that someone else needs these four thousand-year-old immortal mushrooms, so you plan to steal them back. "
The old man's words made Ye Feng tremble.
He immediately asked: "Senior sister? Senior, who is it...who did I steal it for?"
As long as it is clear who the original owner stole the fairy zhi for, the murderer will be out.
It must be that this person did not follow martial ethics and killed people after taking Xianzhi.
"You didn't say, I guess it's a girl."
"Girl? Are you sure?"
"Die for a girl, die for a girl, take the exam for a top scholar for a girl.
You, a young and promising young man, are you going to steal things for a man? It must be for women! "
The old man's words made Ye Feng fall into deep thought.
title_en: Chapter 13: Die for a girl, die for a girl, and take the exam for the top scholar Chapter 14: The Five True Sects and the Six Demonic Sects
